description: Logs that a check-in call with one field worker (staffId, from read the wellness queue) happened, as Log does on the Check-in tab: an optional note, the channel (call default, text, email, in_person), sharedEventIds for the feedback items it covered (crossed off), and callId to attach the matched call. It resets their next check-in. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: complete_wellness_check
title: Log a wellness check-in call
